name: Chelydridae
detail: The Chelydridae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Snapping turtles" — were first discovered in 1831 by Gray.

name: Emydidae
detail: The Emydidae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Pond or water turtles" — were first discovered in 1815 by Rafinesque.

name: Platysternidae
detail: The Platysternidae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Big-headed turtle" — were first discovered in 1869 by Gray.

name: Chelidae
detail: The Chelidae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Austro-American sideneck turtles" — were first discovered in 1831 by Gray.
